propositions: ADR 0035 §(d) lacks concrete specification of the backend interface, blocking decomposition and plan-review of Phase 2 implementation stories.
The reconciler must pin the role-Protocol design: TicketTransport, OutboundMapper, InboundMapper, FieldSanitizer, IdentityConvention, plus opt-in capability Protocols.
The canonical ticket model should be rebar's local ticket format, not a separate CanonicalTicket, with adapters translating vendor↔local via existing mappers.
RemoteRef (vendor, instance, remote_id) must replace hardcoded vendor literals and bare remote identifiers in apply_inbound_records.py.
The Backend facade and registry keyed on config.reconciler.backend must unify role Protocols into a single seam contract.
